title: Stale leaderboard from vacancy A is attributed to vacancy B when route is VacancyEdit/Comparison (no leaderboard reset), yielding a fabricated /vacancies/B/applications/<aid-of-A> deep link
detail: Route changes to VacancyDetail/VacancyHandoff reset leaderboard to Loading, but the VacancyEdit and Comparison branches do not. Sequence: VacancyDetail(A) (leaderboard Success A-entries) -> VacancyEdit(B) via URL. Clicking an application notification for an app in A resolves Some(B) and navigates to a vacancy that does not own the application.
recommended_fix: Track the vacancy id the leaderboard was fetched for (e.g. leaderboard_vacancy_id) and require it to equal the route vid before returning Some(vid), or reset leaderboard on VacancyEdit/Comparison entry.
